verdict.rationale: The SDK's own Files API documents reading and writing files in the sandbox filesystem, with readFile/writeFile, mkdir, and ReadableStream content for binary data and files over 32 MiB, which covers upload-style writes. No explicit download or streaming-read capability is documented beyond readFile, so the story is not completely covered. Missing for 10: an explicit documented download/streaming file-retrieval method (e.g. binary or large-file reads), dedicated upload API documentation, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can read, write, upload, and download files in the sandbox filesystem via the SDK

citations.quote: Read, write, and manage files in the sandbox filesystem. All paths are absolute (e.g., `/workspace/app.js`).
the writeFile() method supports passing a ReadableStream as the content parameter. This allows binary data and files greater than 32 MiB
